items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: once in awhile I'd go into a record shop and hear somebody like Johnny Dunn who played trumpet

ctx.x: Did you hear the New Orleans Rhythm Kings playing.

No, I never did. Never bought their records. I remember -- well, you see there were race records in those days, and the colored records, once in awhile I'd go into a record shop and hear somebody like Johnny Dunn who played trumpet, --
